# Wyrd

> Wyrd is open-source AI assurance and verification infrastructure. Verify AI systems before and after release, with verdicts you can trace, reproduce, and audit.

## Home

- [Wyrd docs](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/): the docs home, with a link to each published section.

## Get started

- [What Wyrd verifies](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/get-started/introduction/): Wyrd checks that an AI system behaves the way its declaration says it should, before and after deployment.
- [Set up Wyrd](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/get-started/setup/): Run a Wyrd server on your machine, save its first credential, and make an authenticated request.
- [Verify your first agent](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/get-started/quickstart/): Run the support-desk API against your local server, get verdicts from three Verifiers, and query the evidence behind them.

## Build and verify

- [Define a Service](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/build-and-verify/declare/define-a-service/): Declare a Service as a folder of Card files, with exact component versions and a table for the rows it records, then validate it locally.
- [Bind a Verifier](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/build-and-verify/declare/bind-a-verifier/): Attach a Verifier to a Service or one of its components with verified_by, and choose whether your code or a schedule runs it.
- [Declare and inspect a Service](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/build-and-verify/declare/declare-and-inspect/): Declare a Service and every Card it references in one call, then read back its exact versions and the relationships the server derived.
- [Record a run and observations](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/build-and-verify/observe/record-a-run-and-observations/): Load your Service's bundle, record rows inside a run, verify or submit them to a Verifier, and read them back by run ID.
- [Write and query custom data with Bifrost](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/build-and-verify/observe/write-and-query-custom-data-with-bifrost/): Connect to Bifrost directly to register a table, load rows, and query any table you can read with SQL.
- [Author a Verifier](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/build-and-verify/verify/author-a-verifier/): Write a Verifier Card from its inputs and requirements, starting with a one-line assertion and working up to a model judge that cites a document.
- [Verify a request in real time](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/build-and-verify/verify/verify-a-request-in-real-time/): Call a bound Verifier from your service while a request is in flight, act on the verdict, and read the requirement breakdown.
- [Monitor drift](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/build-and-verify/verify/monitor-drift/): Compare the inputs your service sees with a healthy baseline on a schedule, and get paged when they shift.
- [Run a verification and inspect its evidence](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/build-and-verify/verify/run-a-verification-and-inspect-its-evidence/): Queue a Verifier with submit, follow its execution from any process, tell a failed verdict from a check that never ran, and read the stored evidence.
- [Respond to a failed verification](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/build-and-verify/verify/respond-to-a-failed-verification/): Page someone when a submitted or scheduled Verifier fails, with an Operator Card, an operator connection, and on_failure, then check that the page was delivered.

## Connect

- [Set up the LLM gateway](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/connect/set-up-the-llm-gateway/): Store a provider key with the Wyrd server, name a deployment for it, and call the model through Wyrd with your Wyrd credential.
- [Make gateway requests from a framework](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/connect/call-wyrd-from-a-stock-client/): Run inference through a named Wyrd gateway deployment from the OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google GenAI SDKs, the OpenAI Agents SDK, and Pydantic AI.
- [Connect an agent through MCP](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/connect/connect-an-agent-through-mcp/): Give Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Pi, or Hermes Agent Wyrd's tools with wyrd mcp install, against a local or deployed server.

## Operate

- [Deploy Wyrd for a team](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/operate/deploy-wyrd-for-a-team/): Prepare PostgreSQL with a platform login and a tenant login, migrate it, start the server, and create the first tenant.
- [Grant and inspect permissions](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/operate/grant-and-inspect-permissions/): See which roles a principal holds, grant or revoke a role, cut a principal off, and confirm the result in the audit log.
- [Configure the verification runtime](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/operate/configure-verification-runtime/): Install the Python worker, choose which processes run Verifiers, size the worker pool, and diagnose startup refusals.
- [Troubleshoot a deployment](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/operate/troubleshoot-a-deployment/): Find the cause of a Wyrd server that refuses to migrate or start, from the message it prints.

## Understand

- [Cards, versions, and relationships](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/understand/cards-versions-and-relationships/): A Service declaration is a set of versioned Cards, each one a defined component of your system.
- [How verification works](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/understand/how-verification-works/): Inputs, steps, requirements, and decide; verify versus submit; executions, verdicts, results, and Operators.
- [Runs, observations, and retained evidence](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/understand/runs-observations-and-evidence/): How Wyrd records what a declared service actually does, and ties each observation to the version that ran.
- [Bifrost](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/understand/bifrost/): Wyrd's analytical warehouse, the two ways to write to it, and when a written row becomes queryable.
- [Identity and authorization](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/understand/identity-and-authorization/): Every call to Wyrd is made as a principal whose roles decide what it may do, and every decision is audited.

## Reference

- [Verifier Card](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/reference/verifier-card/): Every field of a Verifier spec, its input slots, steps, checks, operators, references, citations, and outcomes.
- [MCP tools](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/reference/mcp-tools/): Exact Wyrd tool names, permissions, argument and result shapes, refusals, and query limits.
- [Extraction output](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/reference/extraction-output/): The exact JSON an extract step returns for every media format, how to address it from assertions and citations, and what extraction does not do.
- [Verification runtime limits](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/reference/verification-runtime-limits/): Server environment settings that bound Verifier files, extraction, workspaces, Python code, and real-time deadlines, with their defaults and startup rules.
- [Agent tools and authorization](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/reference/agent-tools-and-authorization/): The built-in tools a Verifier's Agent can call, how they are selected, and the permissions every call needs.
- [Error codes](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/api/errors/): Every stable Wyrd error code with its HTTP status, title, and fix.
- [HTTP API](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/api/openapi/): Where a Wyrd server serves its OpenAPI document and how to use it.

## Machine-readable reference

- [llms-full.txt](https://bohmian-ai.github.io/wyrd/llms-full.txt): this index as the full machine-readable reference.
